step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Majid Al Futtaim's data platform architecture ('The Grid'). On the left, MetaManager runs on Amazon EKS and connects to Elasticsearch/Neo4j for data discovery and schema metadata, while receiving metadata/schema discovery requests from external Multiple Data Sources. In the center, a Data Lake container on Amazon S3 interacts bi-directionally with Apache Kafka (MSK) and Amazon EMR for batch and stream ingestion. External components below the line include Multiple Data Sources streaming to/from Kafka and Applications interacting bi-directionally with EMR. On the right, curated data from S3 feeds into Amazon RDS, while EMR feeds into Vertica for consumption by Data Analysts and Data Scientists (DA/DS).

graph.name: Majid Al Futtaim Centralized Data Lake and Streaming Architecture
graph.notes: The architecture shows an end-to-end data lake platform utilizing EKS for metadata management, MSK (Kafka) and EMR for ingestion/processing into S3, and RDS / Vertica for analytics consumption.
